name: Container registry publish guard
summary: Block direct publication of container images, Helm charts, and OCI artifacts.
description: A deterministic Claude Code PreToolUse gate that recognizes Docker, Podman, ORAS, buildx, and Helm publication commands while allowing local build, load, inspect, scan, and packaging operations.
refuses: It does not push, sign, copy, delete, or promote registry artifacts.
It does not inspect registry credentials, ownership, or retention policy.
It does not accept a tag, registry name, or prompt as publication approval.

entrypoints.purpose: Recognize OCI and chart publication commands and refuse registry writes.
